findings.title: Unpinned selection-affecting threshold in engine.illiq (violates impl_contract's own pinning law)
findings.detail: impl/samv1/engine.py:119 'if len(terms) < max(D // 2, 1): return None' silently drops a name from the eligible universe entirely when fewer than 10 (D=21) / 31 (D=63) valid formation terms survive the class-i/ii guards. Neither plan §3 (mean over the D most recent served sessions, no minimum), family_contract.json, division_site_register.json (which pins only per-name-day exclusion+counting), nor impl_contract.json decisions pin this threshold — while impl_contract declares 'Every implementation decision not fixed by the plan/D1 set is pinned HERE before any PnL exists'. The threshold shapes the ILLIQ cross-section (sparse-history names excluded rather than ranked on available terms), i.e. it is exactly the class of hidden parameter the freeze discipline exists to neutralize. Per audit law, divergence plan-vs-code-vs-impl_contract = HIGH.

findings.title: SPY benchmark diverges from the frozen 'total-return buy-and-hold' definition, in the anchor-flattering direction, and is unpinned
findings.detail: Plan §4 F7 and d1/evaluation_contract.json freeze the comparison as 'SPY total-return buy-and-hold exposure-matched on the same clock'. benchmarks.spy_twin instead round-trips SPY on every 21-session grid date (~11-12 round trips per fold; band-A entry+exit each trip => roughly 2.2-2.4%/fold of artificial benchmark cost drag), inflating the frozen Stage-A gate 'SPY-excess positive >= 2/3 folds at matched exposure'. The spy-twin construction is also absent from impl_contract decisions (random twin and matched book are pinned; spy twin is not). Additionally the entire benchmarks module is dead code: run_cells never imports or invokes it, and no test exercises it.

findings.title: Owner-required matched-characteristic book is structurally vacuous
findings.detail: benchmarks.matched_book reads drec['book_codes'] (benchmarks.py:169), but portfolio.simulate never emits 'book_codes' in per_date (keys: date/fold/n_elig/n_book/bookable), so anchor_members is always the empty set and the matched book is always flat — zero entries by construction. The module is also unwired from run_cells (never called in dry-run or scored mode) and untested. The plan's core question — whether apparent profit is size/volatility wearing an illiquidity label (§1), with the matched book as the owner-required peer comparison (§4 F7) — cannot be answered by the committed code.

findings.title: Frozen evaluation-contract report shape is implemented nowhere; scored records cannot feed it without post-PnL evaluation-code changes
findings.detail: d1/evaluation_contract.json requires per-cell ANNUAL_SPLIT_2021/2022 rows (impl_contract pins annual_split_marks; engine.ANNUAL_MARKS is defined but referenced by nothing), Stage-A gates require drop-one-ticker and drop-one-year survival, and §9 requires market-beta vs SPY and vol-tercile attribution — none of these is implemented in any committed code path (grep: only docstring mentions). run_cells scored mode persists only per-fold summaries + mdd + concentration, not per-hold rows, so the missing pieces cannot be derived from the scored records without writing/changing evaluation code AFTER PnL exists — precisely the post-hoc-rescue pattern the plan's freeze law (§3, D1 evaluation freeze) exists to prevent. Combined with H-2/H-3 the evaluation layer as committed cannot produce the frozen §9 shape.

findings.title: Golden-test coverage below the frozen §8 scope
findings.detail: Plan §8 mandates negative-division fixtures injected into 'anchor, neighbour, CONTROL, matched-book and benchmark paths', class-(iv) fail-loud, and division-site-register completeness. test_golden.py injects classes i/ii into the anchor (illiq) path only; there is no past_ret5 (control) negative fixture, no matched-book or benchmark fixtures (impossible while H-2/H-3 stand), no class-(iv) statistical-denominator fail-loud test (_vol60's len>=30 guard means the (len-1) dof division is unreachable — untested), and no register-completeness test. 14/14 pass, but the passing set is strictly smaller than the frozen contract, so 'golden tests PASS' as a scoring-gate precondition is not yet true in substance.

findings.title: Plan §5 trial-identity fields missing from cell records
findings.detail: Plan §5 requires per-cell trial identity: cycle_id, family_id, arm_id, arm_config_digest, data_snapshot_digest, code_freeze_sha, cost_tier, fold contract. Records (dry-run and scored code path) carry cell_id/cycle_id/arm_id/axis/mode + counters only. Binding note if the cycle later proceeds: identity fields must accompany the scored records/report.

findings.title: Fail-loud implemented as 'return E.FailLoud(...)' (returns, never raises) in two scored-mode sites
findings.detail: evaluate.fold_summary profit_factor 0/0 case and evaluate.concentration.share() return the FailLoud instance instead of raising it. Consequence: the pinned semantics (class-iii TECHABORT; concentration shares 'reported verbatim as not-computable') degrade to an accidental TypeError crash (share()*100) or a non-JSON-serializable value surfacing at record write. Direction is fail-closed (no wrong number can be emitted), but concentration is computed unconditionally in scored mode and crashes when total net PnL <= 0 — a plausible losing branch — which can abort the scored run mid-way and create §5 observed-denominator ambiguity (computed-but-unpersisted outcomes still count as observed).

findings.title: Uncounted skip class: names with no served bar at the decision date
findings.detail: Plan §3 eligibility: 'served bar at t and t+1 (else name skipped, counted)'. portfolio.simulate counts the missing-t+1 class (guards.names_skipped_no_t1) but skips names with no bar at t via 'if bi is None: continue' with no counter increment. Disclosure duty partially unmet; N_eligible denominators exclude this class silently (selection outcome unaffected — such names are unpriceable at t).

findings.title: Backward-adjusted retrieval basis: disclosed, assessed immaterial to the rank cross-section
findings.detail: The pull is 2026 retrieval of 2017-2022 bars; adjusted_close is backward-adjusted with information through retrieval. Assessed NOT a material undisclosed lookahead: (a) disclosed in dollar_volume_contract.rationale; (b) splits — the material adjustments — fully neutralized by the frozen same-basis pair (DV = adjusted_close x split-adjusted volume = true dollars traded regardless of quote basis; F3a 4/4 SPLIT_ADJUSTED); (c) dividend components rescale a single name's DV/ILLIQ by ~1-2% per ex-date distance, orders of magnitude below cross-sectional ILLIQ dispersion driving quintile ranks; (d) r is an adjacent-day same-name ratio so uniform factors cancel; (e) post-2022 ex-date adjustments (CMG 50:1 2024) place each name on a consistent within-name basis and import no cross-sectional information. Carried as a documented caveat, not a blocker.

findings.title: fold_contract.json named in plan §6 but folds pinned inside family_contract.json
findings.detail: Plan §6 lists 'fold_contract.json' among the D1 commits; the D1 set pins folds in family_contract.json's 'folds' block (F1/F2/F3 boundaries, floors, annual split law) instead. Substance satisfied (folds frozen and committed before any PnL, byte-identical to plan §3); letter deviates. No action implied beyond recording the deviation.

verdict_rationale: Prelaunch (§19.3 first key) authorizes the scored execution of the 3 frozen cells. As committed at a80a7a69, that execution would (H-1) run with an unpinned selection-affecting threshold inside the ILLIQ formation, and (H-2/H-3/H-4) produce scored records that cannot be assembled into the frozen §9/evaluation_contract shape — SPY benchmark constructed divergently from its frozen buy-and-hold definition in the anchor-flattering direction, the owner-required matched book structurally incapable of producing a single entry, and annual-split/beta/drop-one rows implemented nowhere with per-hold rows not persisted — so conformance could only be reached by changing evaluation code after PnL exists, which the freeze law forbids. Golden coverage is below the frozen §8 scope (H-5), so the 'golden tests PASS' precondition is not true in substance. Five unresolved HIGHs force REFUSED under the zero-HIGH bar; the incentive asymmetry was weighed — authorizing would risk burning the entire 3-cell trial budget into a report shape the code cannot legally produce. The signal/execution core, dry-run hygiene, freeze chronology, S1 seal, boundaries and drift checks are clean; a fresh-context re-audit after remediation is the path back to the gate.
